verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Data Privacy Controls and Consent Filters that let mParticle customers honor their own end users' GDPR consent and CCPA opt-outs when forwarding data. That is an adjacent capability for managing customer data, not a way for the product's user to opt out of mParticle's own telemetry or usage tracking. Nothing in the pack describes such an opt-out for mParticle's SDKs, dashboard or tooling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
